name: Stabilizes Reality
description: You specialize in maintaining normalcy in areas affected by reality-altering anomalies.
connectionOptions: One PC was saved from a reality shift by your quick action.
You're monitoring a subtle reality fluctuation near one PC's home.
One PC is fascinated by your ability to perceive reality shifts.
You once accidentally caused a minor reality shift affecting one PC.

abilities.name: Reality Sense
abilities.description: You can detect subtle changes in local reality. You're trained in perceiving and understanding reality fluctuations.

abilities.name: Anchor Deployment
abilities.description: You can quickly deploy a Scranton Reality Anchor, stabilizing reality in an immediate area for 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Hume Field Manipulation
abilities.description: You can adjust local hume levels slightly, providing an asset to tasks resisting reality alterations for you and nearby allies.

abilities.name: Reality Bubble
abilities.description: You can create a small bubble of stable reality that moves with you, providing protection against minor reality shifts for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Anomaly Suppression
abilities.description: You can attempt to suppress a localized reality-bending anomaly for up to 1 hour. This requires a difficult Intellect roll.

abilities.name: Reality Restoration
abilities.description: You can attempt to restore a small area to its proper reality state, undoing the effects of reality-altering anomalies.

abilities.name: Pocket Universe
abilities.description: Once per day, you can create a temporary pocket universe with stable reality, which lasts for up to an hour and can hold up to 5 people.
